sources: https://experienceoconee.com/parks/chau-ram-park (Cloudflare-protected; text as captured 2026-10-14 in audit/price_research/reserveamerica_2026-10-14/pages.jsonl, a headless re-read 2026-10-21 rendered only the menu)

values.note: Every site has water and electric; the county does not state the amperage.

hookups.source: https://experienceoconee.com/parks/chau-ram-park ('26 campsites, ready with water and electricity'; 'Electric and Water Hookups'), captured 2026-10-14

values.note: 26 campsites, for RVs or tents (up to one RV and one tent, or two tents, per site; six people). 'Campground roads are narrow. Check ahead for larger campers.'

sites.source: https://experienceoconee.com/parks/chau-ram-park ('Number of Sites: 26'; 'Campground roads are narrow. Check ahead for larger campers.') + https://experienceoconee.com/park-fees/chau-ram-fees (restrictions) + ReserveAmerica site types (Standard 26), captured 2026-10-14

values.note: 'Campground closed mid-November through February'; contact the park for specific dates. The park stays open for day use except about three weeks near Christmas.

season.source: https://experienceoconee.com/parks/chau-ram-park ('Season: Campground closed mid-November through February. Park open for day use year round except three weeks near Christmas. Contact park for specific dates.'), captured 2026-10-14

values.note: Reserve on ReserveAmerica or the call center (855-622-6727) up to 11 months ahead; county residents up to 12 months in person, and must call the PRT office (864-888-1488) once to set up the resident rate. 'Chau Ram park has no minimum night requirements.' Maximum 30 days March-October. Check-out noon; gate closed dusk-7 am.

booking.source: https://experienceoconee.com/reservations ('Reservations may be made up to 11 months in advance'; 'Maximum length of stay is 30 days March-October'; 'Chau Ram park has no minimum night requirements') + https://experienceoconee.com/parks/chau-ram-park (check-out, gate hours), captured 2026-10-14

values.note: The fee page lists $20 a night for an Oconee County resident and $30 for everyone else, with no discounts. The county's reservations page instead says 'Camping rates are $25/night for standard sites ... all taxes included' with residents getting $5 off. $5 parking per car per day.

fees.source: https://experienceoconee.com/park-fees/chau-ram-fees ('Oconee County Residents (Per Night) $20.00 - Normal Site'; 'Non-Residents (Per Night) $30.00 - Normal Site'; 'No discounts will be offered with this schedule') + https://experienceoconee.com/reservations ('Camping rates are $25/night for standard sites and $30/night waterfront sites all taxes included. Oconee County residents will receive a $5/night discount'), captured 2026-10-14

note: Oconee County park at the confluence of Ramsey Creek and the Chauga River, with a 40-ft waterfall and a suspension bridge over the river. Campground roads narrow - 23-ft generally OK. --Claude
summary: County pages confirm water + electric (amps not stated), showers, dump, ReserveAmerica booking, $20 resident / $30 non-resident. Changed site count 34 -> 26 (county and ReserveAmerica both 26; no separate tent sites listed); season now opens 03-01 with the 'closed mid-November through February' wording; added 11-month window, 30-night max, no minimum. Note trimmed. The two county pages disagree on the rate ($20/$30 vs $25 all-in), recorded in fees.note.
flags: The county's two official pages disagree on price: the Chau Ram fee page says $20 resident / $30 non-resident per night; the reservations page says $25 a night all taxes included, residents $5 off. Fees kept from the fee page with both in the note.
